key_provisions_or_claims: Sets basic principles: AI promotion, competitiveness, national security, and appropriate/transparent development and use.
Allocates responsibilities to national and local governments, research institutes, business operators and citizens.
Requires the government to issue guidelines aligned with international norms and to investigate cases of rights infringement.
Mandates a cabinet-approved AI Basic Plan.
Establishes an AI Strategic Headquarters under the Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister.
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Act No. 53 of 2025 on promoting AI research, development and utilization. It sets basic principles favouring innovation and competitiveness while addressing misuse, creates responsibilities for stakeholders, requires an AI Basic Plan, and establishes a Cabinet-level AI Strategic Headquarters chaired by the Prime Minister. It contains no robot-specific provisions.
